seo.title: Chatbot analytics: questions, channels and busy hours | Steps AI
seo.description: See how many chats your agents handle, what customers ask, which channels they use and when they message, by agent or across your account.

hero.title: See what customers ask and when they ask it.
hero.body: Track chats, messages and response times, see which channels bring conversations, and find the hours your customers are most active. View one agent or your whole account.
hero.reassurance: Clear definitions. Any date range. One agent or all of them.

steps.title: From conversations to decisions.
steps.intro: Analytics turns everyday chats into something you can act on.

items.title: Pick a date range
items.body: Choose today, the last 7 or 30 days, a month or a custom range.

items.title: Choose the agent
items.body: See all agents together, or open one agent’s performance.

items.title: Read the headline numbers
items.body: Total chats, total messages, average AI response time and ticket resolution rate.

items.title: Find the patterns
items.body: Chats over time, channel breakdown, an activity heat map and the questions customers ask most.

features.title: What you can see.
features.intro: Each report answers one clear question.

items.title: Chats and messages over time
items.body: See how conversation volume changes day by day.

items.title: Channel breakdown
items.body: See which channels bring the most conversations.

items.title: Activity heat map
items.body: See which days and hours customers message, including late at night.

items.title: What customers are asking
items.body: A ranked list of the questions customers ask most.

items.title: Agent comparison
items.body: Compare conversations, messages per chat, response time, tickets and leads across agents.

items.title: Leads by topic and source
items.body: See which topics and marketing sources bring leads, based on conversation tags.

items.title: Where customers are
items.body: See countries and cities on a map. State-level location is available for website chats.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Average response time measures the AI agent, not your team.
Lifecycle and intent reports show where tagged conversations sit. They are not sales funnels.
WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger do not share state-level location.

items.q: Does response time include my team?
items.a: No. Average response time is for the AI agent’s replies.

items.q: Can I see results for one agent?
items.a: Yes. Each agent has its own performance view, and the account view can show all or one agent.

items.q: Where do topics and sources come from?
items.a: From tags the agent applies to conversations, using rules you can edit in plain English.
